messages:
Nina Park: Hey @eng-runtime, urgent request for the launch blog + webinar next Tue. We need validated bench numbers and reproducible artifacts for three configs: redwood-3b-gguf, redwood-7b-q4, redwood-13b-fp16. Targets: seq=512 and seq=2048. Workloads: single-stream (concurrency=1) and burst (concurrency=16).

Nina Park: Deliverables: single CSV summary, raw logs, exact docker image tags + env, sample input files for both seq lengths, and one short example output per model. Also a one-line plain-English takeaway per model for the blog table.

Tom Alvarez: We can run this. Clarify: report tokens/s at the model output layer, and include both hosted cost estimate (use staging/dev pricing) and a GPU-op normalized metric?

Nina Park: Yes to both. Also include notes on warmup, seed, and any kernel selection variance.

Riley Singh: Plan: run 512 today (50 iterations, seed=2026, warmup=6), then 2048 tomorrow morning. I will dump kernel names (--dump-kernels) and set CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES for consistency. Will upload to bench.reports and post link.

Riley Singh: Smoke commands (will add envs in README):
```
# single-stream
docker run --rm -e MODEL=redwood-7b-q4 ghcr.io/redwood/bench:stable \
  ./bench --model $MODEL --concurrency 1 --seq 512 --runs 50 --seed 2026 --warmup 6 --out /out/$MODEL-512.json

# burst
docker run --rm -e MODEL=redwood-7b-q4 ghcr.io/redwood/bench:stable \
  ./bench --model $MODEL --concurrency 16 --seq 2048 --batch 4 --runs 25 --seed 2026 --warmup 6 --out /out/$MODEL-2048.json
```

Tom Alvarez: Note on variability: long-context runs often show 10%+ p99 jitter due to kernel selection. We'll include median/p90/p99 and raw per-request traces so marketing can inspect outliers.

Nina Park: Also please include a very short demo payload we can run in the webinar (must finish <45s). Keep deterministic if possible.

Riley Singh: Suggested demo payload:
{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"List three practical tips for reducing inference latency in LLM apps."}],"max_tokens":120}

infra-bot: bench job 77021 started for redwood-7b-q4 seq=512 (owner: riley.singh). Report: https://bench.internal/reports/77021

Riley Singh: Uploaded 512 artifacts: https://bench.internal/reports/77021 — includes raw logs, kernel dump, preliminary CSV, and README with exact commands. Starting 2048 now, will post final consolidated CSV + one-liners when done.

Nina Park: Perfect — marketing will hold slide updates until your final. If 2048 p99 is bad, flag suggested mitigations (batch, quant variant, or caching) and a recommended fall-back blurb.

Tom Alvarez: Will do. ETA final artifacts: EOD tomorrow.
